title: Concept: Dependency declared with an implausibly large major
description: package.json declares a major version far larger than any the project has published, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Dependency-confusion and typosquat campaigns publish inflated versions so a permissive range resolves to them; the pin is what makes that possible.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: Dependency-confusion and typosquat campaigns publish inflated versions so a permissive range resolves to them; the pin is what makes that possible.
